description: This Java class, OfbizAmountTransform, extends OfbizNumberTransform to provide a specific Freemarker transform that formats amounts as numbers with a predefined format. It primarily overrides the getWriter method to set the format to UtilFormatOut.AMOUNT_FORMAT and to pass the amount argument for rendering

classes.name: OfbizAmountTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker transform class for formatting amounts, extending OfbizNumberTransform, ensuring amount values are formatted consistently as per AMOUNT_FORMAT

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Overrides the base method to inject amount formatting into the arguments and then calls the parent class's getWriter method
